Are you a retail buyer of silver, struggling to track your stock levels, costs, and sales?
especially when dealing with volatile commodities like silver.
and we recommend a well-organized inventory spreadsheet as the foundation for smart buying and selling decisions.
Accurate inventory management also allows you to react quickly to market fluctuations and adjust your purchasing strategy.
It’s a critical component of a successful silver retail business.
We recommend Google Sheets for its ease of collaboration and accessibility.
Purchase Date: The date you acquired the silver.
Quantity in Stock: The number of units you currently have on hand.
Total Value (in Stock): Calculated automatically (Unit Cost Quantity in Stock).
Sales Quantity: The number of units sold.
Profit (per unit): Calculated automatically (Sales Price - Unit Cost).
Reorder Point: The quantity at which you need to reorder the item.
Use formulas to calculate the ‘Unit Cost, ’ ‘Total Value (in Stock)’, ‘Profit (per unit)’
in the cell for ‘Unit Cost’ (assuming ‘Purchase Price’ is in column F and ‘Quantity in Stock’ is in column G)
you would enter the formula =F6/G6.
Include shipping costs, insurance, and any other expenses associated with acquiring the silver.
Ignoring Sales Data: Your inventory spreadsheet should reflect your sales.
Lack of Reorder Points: Without reorder points, you risk running out of stock, losing sales
First-Out): This method assumes that the first silver items you purchased are the first ones sold.
Batch Tracking: If you receive large shipments of silver
Barcode Scanning: Consider using barcode scanners to speed up data entry and reduce errors.
When tracking silver, consider these unique factors: For more on this
Spot Price Fluctuations: Silver prices can change dramatically in short periods.
Different Silver Forms: Track the specific form of silver - bullion, coins
Gross Profit Margin: This is the percentage of profit you make on each silver item sold.
We recommend a gross profit margin of at least 20 percent for a successful silver retail operation.
Building a silver inventory spreadsheet is a foundational step toward profitable silver retail.
